name: @threepipe/cloud-worker
description: threepipe-cloud: the Cloudflare Worker behind @threepipe/plugin-cloud - reports (Turnstile, caps, redaction, a Discord card, a staff page) and file sharing (named shares, write-once assets, markdown pages), on one D1 database and one R2 bucket
//: wrangler, vitest, esbuild, miniflare and typescript come from the repository root's node_modules (npm install at the root first).

scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev --local --ip 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-9389} --var TURNSTILE_SECRET:1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA --var STAFF_TOKENS:dev=dev-staff-token-local --var SHARE_TOKENS:dev=dev-share-token-local
scripts.deploy: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy
